```sql
SELECT AVG(t.Amount)
FROM main.transactions_1k t
JOIN main.customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date >= '2012-08-23' 
  AND t.Date <= '2012-08-26'
  AND c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND c.Segment = 'LAM'
```
